summary: Comprehensive testing of NEW multi-tenant JWT auth (Jan 2026 rewrite). Backend: 10/10 pytest cases passed covering Grace login (new email), old email rejection, wrong-password 401, protected-route 401 without token, /me endpoint, new-user registration with zeroed data + 3 template reminders copied, duplicate-registration 409, Google social login (isolated + reused on 2nd call), Apple social login, and data-isolation (no Grace steps leaked to new user). passwordHash confirmed NOT present in any auth response. Frontend: verified Fill Demo button auto-fill+auto-submit lands on Grace dashboard (steps 9,890 visible, health score 84), manual Grace login works, wrong password shows 'Invalid email or password' via auth-error-message, signup creates fresh user (Grace's 9890 does NOT leak, new user's name shown in greeting), duplicate signup shows 'An account with this email already exists', Google button lands on isolated Google User dashboard with no Grace data, Apple button works, Continue-as-Grace demo button works. Note: reminders isolation & logout regression flow was blocked mid-test by Cloudflare 429 rate-limiting after rapid successive test runs, but backend test test_register_new_user_zeroed_and_isolated already confirmed 3 template reminders are copied to new users; further reminder-edit-isolation was not UI-verified but backend service is per-userId scoped.
action_items: UPDATE /app/memory/test_credentials.md - it still documents the OLD single-user demo auth (grace@vitality.app, any email/pw works). New auth: Grace=grace.user@email.com/12345678, social accounts google.user@vitality.demo & apple.user@vitality.demo (auto-created on first social login), new registrations create isolated accounts.

Test-created persistent users during this run: 1 registration email of form testfe_<timestamp>@example.com (with password abcdef123, name 'Freddie Tester'). Also google.user@vitality.demo and apple.user@vitality.demo were (re)created by social-login flow. Additional TEST_<uuid>@example.com accounts (with password 'abcdef') were created by pytest runs and left in DB. Main agent may want to clean these up.
Consider adding server-side rate-limit or Cloudflare bypass for automated E2E tests - Cloudflare 429 triggered after ~10 rapid nav cycles blocking further UI testing.
critical_code_review_comments: passwordHash correctly stripped from all auth responses (verified via string-scan of /login, /register, /social, /me).
Auth middleware correctly returns 401 for all four protected endpoints when Authorization header is absent.
Data isolation verified: new registered user's dashboard/activity does not contain Grace's steps (9890) - services correctly scope by req.userId.
Social login idempotency verified: second Google login reuses same google.user@vitality.demo account (returns same email).
409 correctly returned for duplicate registration; error surfaces cleanly to UI via auth-error-message testid.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 6 tested flows passed; reminders-isolation UI micro-check skipped due to Cloudflare 429)
